name: PointOps2 Aggregation Kernels
definition: A point operation that aggregates features from neighboring points using learned or computed weights, incorporating relative position offsets. It computes a weighted sum of (input_feature + relative_position) for each neighbor.
summary: PointOps2 Aggregation Kernels efficiently compute weighted feature updates on GPU by fusing lookup, offset addition, and summation into a single CUDA kernel pass.
